svg.aria-label: msp-support-agent proposes a write on the servicedesk-write connection. The approval request names the MCP server servicedesk-write, the tool update_ticket_priority and the full arguments: ticket_number TCK-10544, priority 3 and a reason. Approve: the call goes through API Management, which adds the correlation ID, to the MCP server's write endpoint /write/mcp; the tool changes TCK-10544 to P3 Medium in Dataverse on behalf of the signed-in technician, adds an internal audit note, and the MCP server writes an Agent Action row with the outcome Succeeded. Reject: the tool is never called and nothing changes; in the lab you decline a status change on TCK-10544, which stays New, and the agent says the call was not approved. Duplicate: the same tool with the same arguments for the same user within 10 minutes returns the first result and makes no second change; its Agent Action row, with its own correlation ID, says Duplicate, first result returned. Side panel for TCK-10524: add_public_reply writes a note with the internal flag false, which the customer can read, and add_internal_note writes a note with the internal flag true, for technicians only.

svg.text: Key idea Nothing changes until you approve: a rejected call never reaches the MCP server, and a repeat returns the first result instead of changing the ticket twice.
